# netbox_module_bay_templates (Data Source)

Lists module_bay_template objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_module_bay_templates" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-module_bay_template" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `module_bay_templates` (Attributes List) The matching module_bay_templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--module_bay_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--module_bay_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `module_bay_templates`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `position` (String) Identifier of the bay's position, substituted into the names of the module's components.
- `url` (String)
